The two must be combined by a human (angleWord using the new angle formatter). mcp/mod.rs and mcp/tools.rs conflicts are plain both-sides-added.

**Review (M3, safety tier): needs changes before merge.** The unit design is sound, but the merge with current main has three problems. One of them is a 25.4× rotary-angle risk that no test catches.

**What looks good**
- **One engine seam:** `run_numbered_with` calls `units::refusal` for the whole program, per-op files, per-mount files and `post.exe --units`.
- **Refusals by name:** an unknown unit word is refused by name, and so is a script that declares no `programUnits`.
- **Inch conversion on Fanuc** (audited, not just run):
  - Lengths, peck Q, R/Z, arc IJK, the probe tolerance and the G10 offsets all go through `fu`.
  - Feeds, including the tap feed, go through `ff`.
  - G43 H, the dwell and the rpm are left unscaled, as they should be.
- **Project v59** has a forward migration, pinned by 5 tests.
- **Mutations killed:** dropping the Haas feed conversion fails `program_units.rs:134`, and an unconverted Mazak arc I fails `:129`.

**Local results** (trial merge with main b592eb79, resolved by hand)
- camcraft-post: all suites pass.
- camcraft-app, 34 touched suites: 307 passed, 2 failed (items 2 and 3 below).
- Clippy is clean once the merge artifact is dropped (the unused `verification_report` import).

**Requested before merge**
1. **Rotary angles must not be unit-converted.**
   - Main added `angleWord(letter, v)` = `statesRotary(letter) ? w(letter, v) : ""` (`fanuc.cps` ~121, `doosan-dnm.cps` ~285). In this PR, `w` is the unit-aware length formatter.
   - So taking main's side of that conflict divides A/B/C by 25.4 in an inch program. When I resolved it that way, every PR test still passed.
   - Fix: resolve with `wa(letter, v)` (degrees) and keep main's call sites. Add an inch fixture with A/B/C moves on Fanuc and Doosan, asserting the angle words equal the mm program's.
2. **`tinyg.cps`** is new on main and reads `machine.units` (`tinyg.cps:216`) with no `programUnits`.
   - The PR's own `no_shipped_post_takes_the_program_unit_from_the_machine_file` fails at `program_units.rs:218`.
   - A mm document on an inch TinyG machine file would post an inch program.
   - Fix: take the unit from `postOptions.Units`, or declare TinyG mm-only. Add tinyg and grblhal to `MM_ONLY`.
3. **Refresh the inch goldens after merging main.** Main's #994 (G99 plus a return move) changed all six `golden/nc/inch/*/drill_peck.nc`. After `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`, the word-by-word mm-vs-inch check passes for 6 posts × 8 goldens.
4. **Conflicts to resolve at the merge:**
   - `fanuc.cps` and `doosan-dnm.cps`: see item 1.
   - `mcp/mod.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs` and `posting.rs`: keep both sides.
   - `posting_per_op.rs`: drop `verification_report` from the import.

**Notes**
- Tormach lathe, plasma, grblhal and tinyg are outside the word-by-word inch matrix.
- G20 on a real control and Sinumerik G700/G710 are not exercised. This needs a Hub run or a hand check before it ships.
Fixing the review findings (rotary angle words, tinyg unit law, inch drill_peck goldens) on a merge of upstream/main.

Review findings fixed at b037d84f (merge of upstream/main ac805134 + fix commit). Still a draft: **Hub run still owed.**

**1. Rotary angles (safety).** Merge resolution takes main's `angleWord` call sites in `fanuc.cps` and `doosan-dnm.cps` `tilt()`, and `angleWord` now writes `wa` (degrees), never `w` (the unit-aware length word). Haas, Mazak and Sinumerik write no rotary words (they refuse tilts); Tormach's A index already uses its degree `fa`.
- New pin: `program_units::rotary_angle_words_are_degrees_in_an_inch_program`. It posts mm and inch on Fanuc and Doosan DNM over the A+B tilthead (RTCP arm and modal walk) and on Doosan's 4th-axis index path. It asserts the A/B/C words are `A37.5 B0 A0 B12.25 A-45` / `A90 A127.5` in both units and that the rest is the mm program in inches, word by word.
- Mutation check: with `w` back in `angleWord`, the test fails in Fanuc (`A1.4764` for `A37.5`). With the mutation in Doosan only, it fails in Doosan.

**2. tinyg (and grblhal, same issue).** Both are new on main and read `machine.units`. They already scaled every length and feed when `inch` was set, so they now take `inch` from `postOptions.Units` and declare `programUnits = "mm inch"`, the same as the Tormach mill. I did not make them mm-only, because that would remove a tested inch path. The decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/902-document-units.md`.
- New pin: `program_units::grbl_family_posts_write_the_mm_program_in_inches`. Both posts run over the 8 mill goldens word by word, and `Units: mm` is byte-identical to no unit.
- Mutation check: forcing `inch = false` in tinyg fails it.
- `tinyg_post` / `grblhal_post` now state an inch document instead of an inch machine file, and they pin that an inch machine file alone posts the mm program.
- `no_shipped_post_takes_the_program_unit_from_the_machine_file` is green.

**3. Goldens.** Re-recorded with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test program_units every_inch`. `git status --short` showed only these 6 files moved, all `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/inch/<post>/drill_peck.nc` for doosan-dnm, fanuc, haas, mazak, sinumerik and tormach. Each one is main's #994 change, in inch:
- `G98` becomes `G99`. Sinumerik has no G98/G99 word.
- A return move `G0/G00 X0.7874 Y0.3937 Z0.2362` follows `G80`. That is the mm golden's `Z6`, divided by 25.4.
- Sinumerik's later N numbers shift by one block.
- All 6 keep G20, every length is / 25.4, and they carry no angle words.
- No `contour_plate_with_hole` golden moved, and no mm golden moved.

**4. Hub run:** still owed before merge, and noted in the PR body. It was not attempted.

**Gate** (macOS, worktree target, sccache):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: 42 binaries, 382 passed, 0 failed. This includes the recorded streams, every `script_*` suite and `fanuc_post`.
- camcraft-app `golden_cl conformance posting tormach_fourth_axis rotary_verify program_units units_in_refusals tinyg_post grblhal_post mcp_units units_migrate`: 116 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Hub run still owed.

**Delta re-review (M3, safety tier): all three blockers are fixed. Two things remain before merge: re-merge main (one doc conflict) and the owed Hub run.**

**The three blockers:**
1. **Rotary angles are in degrees again.**
   - `angleWord` now writes through `wa` (`fanuc.cps:139`, `doosan-dnm.cps:303`), and the RTCP, modal and Doosan index paths all go through it.
   - Changing `wa` back to `w` on either post makes `program_units::rotary_angle_words_are_degrees_in_an_inch_program` fail (A1.4764 vs A37.5).
2. **tinyg and grblhal take the unit from `postOptions.Units`** and declare `programUnits = "mm inch"`.
   - Making either read `machine.units` again fails `grbl_family_posts_write_the_mm_program_in_inches` and `no_shipped_post_takes_the_program_unit_from_the_machine_file`.
   - No shipped `.cps` reads `machine.units`, every one declares `programUnits`, and no angle or rotary word goes through the length formatter.
3. **Exactly six inch `drill_peck` goldens moved,** and only by #994's G98 to G99 change plus the return move (Z0.2362 is 6 mm). No other golden moved.

**Local results** (merged with main 84c96835):
- camcraft-post: every suite passes.
- camcraft-app: 23 touched suites pass, including `program_units` 7, `golden_cl` 26, `conformance` 6, `posting` 17, `tinyg_post` 18, `grblhal_post` 9, `units_migrate` 5, `tormach_fourth_axis` 12 and `rotary_letter` 3.
- ui `program_units`: passes.
- Clippy on post, app and ui is clean.

**Before merge:**
1. Merge upstream/main. `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` conflicts in the manifest key list; keep both `serves` (#1266) and `programUnits` (#902).
2. The Hub run of an inch program, still owed. The PR stays a draft until then.

**Labels:** I set the earlier `needs-rework` and have now removed it.

**Hub run, 770MX sim, PathPilot v2.14.4, 2026-11-12.**
- `contour_plate_with_hole_inch.nc` (this head) ran to M30 in 1:19, last line 86. The mm reference from main ran in 1:18, also 86 lines. The plotted extents match: 1.831 in = 46.51 mm, 0.906 in = 23.00 mm, 1.154 in = 29.31 mm. The feeds convert too: F19.69 in/min = F500 mm/min, and F3.94 = F100. **Pass.**
- `drill_peck_inch.nc` alarmed: `G73: Cannot feed with zero feed rate`. The cause is not this PR: main's mm golden has the same G73 with no F. The CL fixture's cycle record carries no feed or tool, and the post does not refuse that. Filed as #1357.

So #981's inch conversion is Hub-confirmed. The drill alarm is a fixture and post refusal gap on main, tracked in #1357.

Merged main twice into this branch (head 47ea06be). Still a draft; the Hub run is still owed.

Hand resolutions:
- `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, `apply.rs`, `mod.rs`: main took project v59 for the fidelity rung (#1056). The document-unit rung is now v59 -> v60 and `PROJECT_VERSION` is 60. Heads-up on head 47ea06be: one pin from main fails here.

`cargo test -p camcraft-app --test lathe_post_css` fails `an_inch_tormach_posts_vc_in_ft_per_min_and_d_in_rpm`. The program posts `G21 ... G96 D3000 S170`. The pin (#1173, new on main) makes its program inch with an inch *machine file*. Under #902 the document's unit decides, and the file's `post` helper calls `engine::run` without `postOptions`.

A fix is on #1126's branch, in commit e528c79c (only its `crates/app/tests/lathe_post_css.rs` part is needed here; its wire-iso half matches your 6696c37c):
- the test sets the document unit (`SetUnits` to inch);
- `post()` passes `posting::program_options(world)` through `engine::run_with`.

The other nine tests in that file post mm documents and are unchanged. With it, lathe_post_css passes 10/10. program_units and units_migrate pass on 47ea06be as is.

I did not push here: the branch was already refreshed and reviewed, so I left the head as it is. #1126 carries 47ea06be plus this fix.

Pushed `4d447c98` on top of 47ea06be, test-only (the user OK'd it): the `lathe_post_css` fix from my earlier comment, so the inch Tormach G96 pin makes its program inch through the document unit. `lathe_post_css` passes 10/10 and `program_units` 7/7 on this head; nothing else changed. The PR is still a draft; it needs a delta look before `merge-ready` applies to this head.
